name: ROHM Co., Ltd.
summary: ROHM Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells electronic components worldwide. The company operates through three segments: ICs, Discrete Semiconductor Devices, and Module. The company provides ICs comprising memory, amplifiers and linear, power management, motor/actuator drivers, resistors, capacitors, clocks and timers, switches and multiplexers, logic, data converters, sensors and MEMS, display drivers, interfaces, wireless LSIs, audio and video products, speech synthesis LSI, and microcontrollers.
